name: personal-os
description: Alex, a Personal Ops System. Node is the logic layer: generators, validators, the recall spine, and (from the bash migration) the Close-Out Gate and the recovery checker.

nodeNotes.why-22: system/recall/ uses node:sqlite, which is only available from Node 22. The recall spine is a hard dependency of the nightly harvest, so 22 is a floor, not a preference.
nodeNotes.why-no-dependencies: Every Node file in this repo imports only builtins (assert, child_process, crypto, fs, https, os, path). That is deliberate: zero npm supply-chain surface on a machine that holds credentials, and `git clone` is a complete install. Verified 2026-08-05 during the bash migration Phase 1. Keep it that way; adding a dependency is a decision, not a convenience.
nodeNotes.why-commonjs: The existing scripts/*.js are CommonJS. New migration files are .mjs so ESM and CJS coexist without a flag day. Do not flip "type" to module without porting every .js file in the same commit.
